newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Japan pledges 142.8 bln yen aid to Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Japan pledges 142.8 bln yen aid to Philippines.

text.p: Japan has pledged a total of 142.8 billion yen in official development assistance to the Philippines, Tokyo's ambassador to the Philippines Hiroyuki Yushita said on Wednesday.

The loans, to be disbursed within one year, were pledged during the annual consultative meeting of the Philippines with its bilateral and multilateral creditors currently being held in Tokyo, Yushita said in a statement.

A yen loan package of 124.3 billion yen comrpised the bulk of the assistance. Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto announced the figure in Manila last month, ahead of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation forum summit.
The package covers 14 development packages, including those at Subic Bay and the southern island of Mindanao.
The rest of the peldges made by Japan include grant assistance of 11 billion yen and technical assistance worth 7.5 billion yen for the development projects, the statement said.
